purpose: Qualify one small, metadata-screened Transformers repository repair as a source-level Development candidate. This protocol does not assign a split or authorize model inference or training.
hypothesis: The exact merge-base source fails a narrowly extracted regression test from Transformers #50219, a minimal wrong mutant of the fixed source fails the same test, and the exact merged source passes in an offline resource-limited runner.

candidate.title_from_frozen_metadata: fix(tests_fetcher): use posix paths throughout, eliminate all os.path.sep/os.path.join patterns
candidate.family_hypothesis: Cross-platform POSIX path handling in Transformers' repository test-fetching utility. Exact relationship to existing task families is UNASSESSED until source-level family review.

verified_prior_identity_filter.result: The candidate identity was absent from the hash-verified set of prior Development, Train, and non-Held-Out candidate-queue identities (22 identities). The filter skips rows marked historical_split=heldout before reading any identity fields, skips qualification rows outside development/train before identity access, and includes only Development exposure events.

remote_branch_name_screen.limitation: This checks only branch names, not every unmerged branch artifact or a model/controller exposure ledger; total prior exposure remains unverified.

source_identity_gates: Verify the exact baseline, PR head, merge commit and merge parent commit objects before reading candidate files.
Verify the expected two changed paths and the repository license after the protocol has been pushed.
Use only the frozen source and test paths plus the license file and strictly necessary test support files. Do not inspect PR discussions, unrelated source, model weights, or any Held-Out artifact.
If the commits, ancestry, paths, license, test isolation, or CPU feasibility differ from the frozen record, stop without substituting another candidate.
qualification_plan.test_overlay: After source access, extract the PR-added or PR-modified assertions from tests/repo_utils/test_tests_fetcher.py at the frozen merge revision, unchanged, into a trusted grader-only overlay. The candidate workspace must not contain the overlay.

arms.name: baseline
arms.test_overlay: The exact frozen regression assertions and necessary support bytes from the merge revision.

arms.name: wrong-mutant
arms.source_mutation: Choose one minimal incorrect reversal of the specific POSIX-path behavior in #50219 and freeze its exact diff and file hash in a source-access execution addendum before invoking any candidate test.

arms.name: upstream-fixed
arms.test_overlay: The identical regression assertions, support files, and harness as baseline and wrong-mutant.

required_outcomes.baseline: Every targeted case fails at the intended behavioral assertion, without import/collection error, skip, timeout, or unrelated failure.
required_outcomes.wrong_mutant: The identical cases reject the incorrect mutation at the intended assertion.
required_outcomes.upstream_fixed: Every targeted case passes without skip or unrelated failure.
required_outcomes.all_arms: Exact source and test hashes, grader separation, sandbox, command, and resource limits match the frozen execution addendum.

execution_addendum_required_before_any_t: exact test IDs and test/support hashes
exact source-file hashes for each arm
sandbox profile, no-network evidence, memory limit, and timeout

isolation.platform: Local macOS Apple Silicon CPU only; no GPU, paid service, or remote execution.
isolation.sandbox: Default-deny macOS Seatbelt or an already available resource-limited Docker/Colima CPU image; no network; candidate source read-only; grader files mounted read-only outside candidate workspace; writes limited to a fresh arm-specific evidence directory.
isolation.retry_rule: Each arm invocation is consumed; retry requires a new hash-bound protocol addendum committed before the retry.

qualification_decision_rule: QUALIFIED_SOURCE_LEVEL only if identity, source, license, baseline, wrong-mutant, upstream-fixed, isolation, and resource gates all pass. A pass does not authorize Development assignment, model inference, training, or Held-Out use.
limitations: Prior model/controller exposure is not fully ruled out by the current-main ledgers and branch-name check; a task assignment requires a separate complete exposure audit.
One source-level task qualification is not an independently graded model repair or coding-capability result.
stop_rules: Do not access candidate source or test until this exact protocol commit is pushed to VARE.
Do not execute any candidate test before a source-access execution addendum is committed and pushed.
Do not open PR bodies, discussion, unrelated patches, task prompts, or any Held-Out task or artifact.
Do not infer or train on this task or assign it to any split under this protocol.
If any pre-run gate fails, retain the failure, keep the task UNQUALIFIED and UNASSIGNED, and do not substitute another candidate.
